mechanism: Nalmefene may potentiate systemic beta-blocker effects through opioid receptor antagonism affecting cardiovascular homeostasis; timolol ophthalmic has minimal systemic absorption but can still cause additive cardiac depression.
action: Monitor heart rate and blood pressure; consider alternative analgesic or ophthalmic beta-blocker if nalmefene use is necessary; counsel patient on signs of bradycardia or hypotension.
